title: Why do muscles cramp? It is probably NOT salt 🥒
caption:
The leading idea now: tired muscles get stuck "on" because the nerve signals that switch them off fail. In one study pickle juice stopped cramps in about 85 seconds, too fast to be the salt. Stretch it out. What cramps on you? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #12
first_comment: Calf cramp at 3am is the worst pain known to humans. Agree? 😩
sources: Schwellnus MP. Cause of exercise associated muscle cramps (EAMC): altered neuromuscular control, dehydration or electrolyte depletion? Br J Sports Med 2009;43:401-408
Miller KC et al. Reflex inhibition of electrically induced muscle cramps in hypohydrated humans. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2010;42:953-961 (pickle juice about 85 s vs about 134 s for water)
Miller KC et al. Gastric emptying after pickle-juice ingestion in rested, euhydrated humans. J Athl Train 2010;45:601-608
